I added a formatting toolbar to the editor for customizable declarations (the assertion template). It has four buttons: bold, italic, center and justify. I haven't run the app or any tests, so it's untested in the browser. I only checked that the Ruby syntax is valid. - **How the buttons work:** each button wraps the selected text in HTML. - Bold uses `…`. - Italic uses `…`. - Center uses `
…
`. - Justify uses `
…
`. With nothing selected, it inserts the empty tags and puts the cursor between them. - **Where it lives:** - `code_mirror_text_area_widget` in `app/helpers/application_helper.rb` takes a new optional `toolbar` argument. It defaults to off, so the email templates and notifications keep their current editors. - `assertion_template_form_column` in `app/helpers/assertions_helper.rb` turns it on. - The button styling is in `app/assets/stylesheets/active_scaffold_overrides.scss`. - **Not checked:** whether the PDF generation for declarations honors `text-align` on a `div`. If it doesn't, the center and justify buttons won't change the printed output.
